comments.author: @Ufrunge
comments.text: You have presented 30 factual claims but where is the supporting evidence? Please provide the original sources and direct references for each individual fact. Viewers should be able to verify these statements independently rather than simply accepting them based on narration

replies.author: @AdventureChuckles
replies.text:
Fair point. You're absolutely right that viewers should be able to verify the information independently.

I'll make sure the description includes a numbered source list with direct links to original research, scientific publications, official government data, and reputable institutions wherever available. I'll also clearly identify estimates and claims where the evidence is still debated.

Accuracy and transparency matter. Thanks for holding us to that standard.
